lines.text: Save R3,834 a month in a tax-free savings account, and you'll go over the limit.
Twelve months of R3,834 is R46,008.
But the yearly limit is R46,000. That's R8 too much.
SARS charges a 40% penalty on every rand above the limit.
On R8, that's only R3.20. But the rule works the same for big mistakes.
Put in R50,000 this year, and the R4,000 extra costs you R1,600.
And the limit counts all your tax-free accounts together. Two accounts don't give you two limits.
So keep your total at R3,833 a month or less, across every account.
The full TFSA guide is on the channel. Follow for a new money rule every day.
Because one extra rand a month is all it takes.
